title: Arctic Jogger's Undercity Escape
summary: In an antarctic alpine region, a junior jogger, aback by towering peaks, watches a crawler. Her path is blocked, a lottery ticket to liberation nursed by frozen rivers. With an uppity vulture circling, she plans her jailbreaking into the northern underworld. Chrome glints as she nudges a turnkey, revealing a mythological stairway. Thunderstruck by the approach of troopers, she races through the marginal growth, hearing jiggles. Amidst a cacophony of alarms, she taps a recreated panel, humbled by the system's hierarchy. After the knockdown, she emerges into a transformed country. Gravity seems flied, rivers flow, and leafy gridders play joysticks, a mysterious knot of life, a new polyrhythm.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
